shellCommands.command: git diff && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100

for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx "app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx" .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cd node_modules/next; ls; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "unstable_instant\|unstable_prefetch" dist --include=*.js -l | head -20
cd /workspace/node_modules/next; cat AGENTS.md; grep -rli "unstable_instant\|prefetch" dist/docs | head -40

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference; cat 04-functions/navigation.md | head -120; grep -n "partialPrefetching" -r 05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md | head; grep -n "navigation" /workspace/node_modules/next/cache.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/web/exports/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

git checkout tsconfig.json && git status --short; grep -o "NEXT_ROUTER_PREFETCH_HEADER[^;]*;" -r node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-headers.js | head; grep -n "export const" node_modules/next/dist/esm/client/components/app-router-headers.js | head -30

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 5
curl -s localhost:3123/projects/acme -H 'rsc: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2' -o /tmp/prefetch.txt -w '%{http_code}\n'
curl -s localhost:3123/projects/acme -H 'rsc: 1' -o /tmp/nav.txt -w '%{http_code}\n'
for f in /tmp/prefetch.txt /tmp/nav.txt; do echo "== $f"; for s in "Acme Storefront" "Loading details" "Commerce storefront"; do printf '%s: ' "$s"; grep -c "$s" $f; done; done

curl -sL localhost:3123/projects/acme -H 'rsc: 1' -H 'next-router-prefetch: 2' -o /tmp/prefetch.txt -w '%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n'
curl -sL localhost:3123/projects/acme -H 'rsc: 1' -o /tmp/nav.txt -w '%{http_code} %{url_effective}\n'
for f in /tmp/prefetch.txt /tmp/nav.txt; do echo "== $f"; for s in "Acme Storefront" "Loading details" "Commerce storefront"; do printf '%s: ' "$s"; grep -c "$s" $f; done; done
pkill -f "next start -p 3123"; rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts; git status --short; git diff -- app next.config.ts
